title: RMC-6236 for Patients with RAS G12 Mutations in Advanced Solid Tumors
brief_summary: Clinical trial 8 for Metastatic Colorectal Adenocarcinoma. This is a Phase 1/1b study.
detailed_description: This clinical trial evaluates the efficacy and safety of investigational therapy for Metastatic Colorectal Adenocarcinoma. Participants will be assessed for response, progression-free survival, and overall survival.
inclusion_criteria: Advanced solid tumor with specific KRAS G12 mutations; Received prior standard therapy; ECOG PS 0-1; Adequate organ function
exclusion_criteria: Active or untreated brain metastases; History of pneumonitis or ILD; Prior RAS-MULTI(ON) inhibitor
eligibility_criteria: Advanced solid tumor with specific KRAS G12 mutations; Received prior standard therapy; ECOG PS 0-1; Adequate organ function. Exclusion: Active or untreated brain metastases; History of pneumonitis or ILD; Prior RAS-MULTI(ON) inhibitor
